$comment: Texas ingest scope: the clauses the game cites. VERIFIED 2026-08 by scripts/probe-tx.mjs. statutes.capitol.texas.gov is an Angular application — every document path there returns the same 250874-byte shell, including the /Docs/CN/htm/ paths that used to serve documents. The application loads the real text from a separate static host, tcss.legis.texas.gov, one HTML document per ARTICLE (not per section): resources/CN/htm/CN.<article-arabic>.htm, article arabic even though the citation is roman. We harvest the article document, hash it, and extract the cited section from it — same guarantee as Missouri, one level up. source_url is the document we hashed; citation_url is the page a person should visit to read it in context. Note art-07:sec-03 is cited as a whole section: subsection (e) carries the local school tax authority, but the section is the citable unit, and the gloss explains which part matters.
